requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: A liquid staking token whose three authority paths all resolve to the same 2-of-3 Safe, with no delay. It scores higher than para's vault because every layer has verified source.
narrative.detail: About 6,317 HYPE delegated, roughly $583K, the lightest tracked target. It was found through the deployer address of the dormant dex vntl. The RoleRegistry owner, OPERATOR_ROLE and the MANAGER_ROLE holder (a verified StakingVaultManager) all resolve to one 2-of-3 Safe. That last link was resolved by reading verified source, where every discretionary admin function is owner-gated; processBatch and finalizeBatch are permissionless but non-discretionary. The check is tied to one implementation and re-confirmed on every run. The Safe's owners are not attributed to named people.
